# Stroke: full reference for LLMs

Stroke is a native database client for engineers and analysts. Query, browse, and edit every database you run, in one fast app.

Stroke runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It launches quickly and stays light on large tables. It ships a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server so AI agents such as Claude and Cursor can read the schema and run queries against a database the user already has open.

Website: https://stroke.click
Source: https://github.com/stroke-app/stroke

## Supported databases

PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, DuckDB, SQL Server, ClickHouse, CockroachDB, Turso / LibSQL, Cloudflare D1. SQLite and DuckDB also run in-memory. Redis is in beta.

## Features

- Schema explorer: tables, views, materialized views, foreign tables, indexes, and enums with live row counts.
- Data grid: paginated browsing, resizable columns, multi-column sort, full-text search, and a visual filter builder that writes the WHERE clause.
- Inline editing: type-aware editors for text, numbers, booleans, enums, dates, UUIDs, and JSON, with changes staged until committed.
- SQL console: a full editor with schema-aware autocomplete, formatting, and execution time.
- Export: any grid or query result to CSV or JSON.
- Schema diagrams: auto-generated ERDs with foreign-key navigation.
- Charts and dashboards: turn query results into charts and pin them to a dashboard.
- AI chat: a schema-aware assistant with database access that runs queries, explains schemas, and drafts SQL.
- MCP server: expose a connection to Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client.
- Command palette: Cmd/Ctrl+K to jump anywhere; every core view has a shortcut.
- SSH tunnels: connect to databases behind a bastion host from inside the app.
- Local AI models: point the AI assistant at a model running on the same machine, so schema and data never leave it.

## Pricing

- Try: $0. Every feature unlocked while evaluating, all engines, all platforms, no account.
- Own: $9.99 once. The app is yours forever, a license key for up to 2 devices, every future update, priority support.
- Team: $99 once. Licenses everyone on a company's email domain; each teammate gets their own key; no seats or per-user fees.

There is no subscription and no renewal.

## Install

macOS: download the .dmg for Apple Silicon or Intel from https://stroke.click/download/macos, or run:

    brew install --cask stroke-app/tap/stroke

Windows: download the EXE or MSI from https://stroke.click/download/windows, or run:

    scoop bucket add stroke https://github.com/stroke-app/stroke
    scoop install stroke

Linux: AppImage, .deb, or .rpm from https://stroke.click/download/linux.

Direct downloads are not code-signed yet. On macOS, right-click the app and choose Open the first time. On Windows, choose More info, then Run anyway in SmartScreen.

## Getting started

1. Download and install Stroke. No account is needed to try it.
2. Choose New connection, pick an engine, and paste a connection string or enter host, port, and credentials. Connections run directly from the user's machine.
3. To keep Stroke, buy a license and paste the key into Settings → License.
4. Turn on the MCP server to let agents query the database.

## MCP setup

Open Stroke → MCP, pick the connection to expose, and turn the server on. Stroke serves MCP locally and shows the endpoint and a ready config for each client. Claude Desktop config (the port may differ):

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "stroke": {
          "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4319/mcp"
        }
      }
    }

In Cursor, open Settings → MCP → Add server and paste the endpoint, or add it to a project's .cursor/mcp.json. The MCP server only runs while Stroke is open and enabled for a connection.

## Privacy

Stroke connects to databases directly from the user's device. Connection credentials are stored locally. Query results never pass through Stroke's servers. Details: https://stroke.click/privacy
